note: Triennial election of the sixteen electoral divisions of Clogher rural district, one member each, polled Thursday 1 June 1961 (Notice of Election, Impartial Reporter, 4 May 1961, p. 8: nomination day Tuesday 16 May 1961). The Returning Officer's 'Notice of Result of Elections', dated 26 May 1961 and printed in the Impartial Reporter of 1 June 1961, p. 8, certifies that the persons named in column 5 were duly elected for the divisions opposite, no polls having been taken. Fifteen of the sixteen divisions are recorded; the Newtownsaville row of the notice is blank, no candidate being returned for that division, and it is omitted rather than filled by inference. No party labels are printed in the notice and none is recorded. Signed by John F. McCrea, Returning Officer. Returned unopposed.
